sections.label: Eco-labelling guidelines for consumers
sections.summary: The Ministry will encourage other eco-label administrators to reference international guidelines, citing the Singapore Green Labelling Scheme and Singapore Green Building Product Labeling Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources if his Ministry will introduce guidelines for the eco-labelling of products to prevent consumers from being potentially misled by non-governmental sanctioned eco-labelling initiatives in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are encouraged by the increasing awareness of eco-labels among consumers in recent years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Eco-labels are one form of environmental performance certification which can be useful in helping consumers make informed decisions when purchasing environmentally friendly products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Taking guidance from them locally are the Singapore Green Labelling Scheme (SGLS), which is administered by the Singapore Environment Council (SEC) and the Singapore Green Building Product Labeling Scheme, which is administered by the Singapore Green Building Council.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: My Ministry will continue to encourage the administrators of other eco-labels to take reference from these international guidelines to build public confidence in the credibility of their labels with a view to move more people towards environmentally sustainable purchasing practices.

sections.label: Government purchases using SGLS
sections.summary: The Government has purchased paper based on the Singapore Green Labelling Scheme from last year, and consumers are urged to use credible bodies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In Singapore, there are credible organisations like SEC, which even the Government has taken the signals from in their purchases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In fact, from last year onwards, we have been purchasing paper based on SGLS issued by SEC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, I urge consumers to use the same credible bodies in making their choices.
